user.title: Real persons
user.description: Real persons are the people whose presence decides whether somebody is at home who is not a virtual tracker. Home Assistant has to be able to locate them on its own, so each of them needs a device tracker.

data_description.persons: At least one person is required. Suggested are the persons that currently have a device tracker; a person without one is usually the person a virtual tracker is meant for.

reconfigure.title: Real persons
reconfigure.description: Change the people whose presence decides whether somebody is at home who is not a virtual tracker. Home Assistant has to be able to locate them on its own, so each of them needs a device tracker.

data_description.persons: At least one person is required. Do not add a person that a virtual tracker is assigned to: switching that tracker on would look like a real arrival.

error.person_has_virtual_tracker: A virtual tracker of this integration is attached to {persons}. Switching that tracker on would look like a real person coming home and reset every virtual tracker, so pick somebody else.

user.title: Add a virtual tracker
user.description: A virtual tracker stands in for a household member without a phone, for example a child, a grandparent or a guest. Assign it to a person of its own afterwards, and that person counts as being at home for as long as the tracker is switched on.

no_tracker.title: No virtual tracker has been added yet
no_tracker.description:
Virtual Presence Tracker is set up, but there is no virtual tracker yet, so nothing happens. A virtual tracker stands in for a household member without a phone, for example a child, a grandparent or a guest.

Add one under Settings > Devices & services > Integrations > Virtual Presence Tracker > "Add virtual tracker". Afterwards assign it to a person of its own, so that person counts as being at home while the tracker is switched on.

tracker_not_assigned.title: The virtual tracker {name} is not assigned to a person
tracker_not_assigned.description:
Nobody counts as being at home when {name} is switched on: the device tracker `{entity_id}` is not part of any person, so Home Assistant has nobody to place at home.

Go to Settings > People, open the person {name} stands for (or add one, no login needed) and pick `{entity_id}` in the list of device trackers of that person. If you do not need the tracker any more, delete it in Settings > Devices & services > Virtual Presence Tracker.

real_person_has_virtual_tracker.title: The real person {person} has a virtual tracker attached
real_person_has_virtual_tracker.description:
{person} is one of the real persons of Virtual Presence Tracker, and the virtual tracker `{tracker}` is attached to that person. Switching that tracker on therefore looks like a real person coming home, which switches every virtual tracker off again.

Fix it in one of two ways: remove `{tracker}` from {person} in Settings > People, or take {person} out of the real persons in Settings > Devices & services > Virtual Presence Tracker > Reconfigure.

real_person_missing.title: The real person {person} no longer exists
real_person_missing.description:
{person} is configured as a real person of Virtual Presence Tracker, but that entity is gone - deleted or renamed. Its presence is no longer taken into account, so virtual trackers may not reset any more when somebody comes home.

Select your real persons again in Settings > Devices & services > Virtual Presence Tracker > Reconfigure.
